tier_1_derived_exact.simple_support: k = min_m (m/alpha + alpha/m)^2, the exact minimisation of the Navier series of the governing Kirchhoff equation; closed against an independent full-series solver at round-off (see analytic_closure)
tier_1_derived_exact.clamped: no closed form exists in Kirchhoff theory; bracketed by the h-extrapolated C1 Hermite FEM ladder and the clamped-admissible polynomial Rayleigh-Ritz upper bound (see fem_sweep.boundary_condition_influence)

tier_2_external_anchor.detail: DNV-RP-C201 plate buckling factors and Timoshenko & Gere plate coefficients cannot be quoted verbatim here; no number is recorded, so no k value in this artifact is a code value

analytic_closure.note: route A is the algebraic minimisation k = min_m (m/alpha + alpha/m)^2 over integer half-waves; route B is the repository's independent full-series Navier solver in dimensional rigidities. They share the governing equation and no code; this is operator closure, not validation against a code or an experiment.

criteria.requirement: verbatim anchor locations >= 2, or an honest WITHHELD
criteria.evidence: 0 of 3 anchors VERBATIM: see anchors.acquisition.attempts for the command-by-command outcomes (filesystem name scan, text scan of docs/papers/benchmarks and /opt/mm-verify, network probe, evidence-corpus listing)
closed-form single-mode coefficient versus the independent full-series Navier solver over the aspect sweep; the sparse FEM assembly is additionally checked against the dense in-repo path at 3.382e-13

criteria.requirement: the influence of the edge boundary condition on k is quantified
criteria.evidence: simple support is exact by algebra; clamping has no closed form and is taken from two constraint realisations of the same C1 Hermite element (nodal slope elimination and a near-rigid edge spring), each Richardson-extrapolated in h, with the gap between them quoted as the window width. The ratio k_clamped/k_simple is reported per aspect ratio, so the boundary-condition effect is a number, not a remark. The clamped number is a discretisation result, not an anchor comparison: an independent formulation check is still OPEN.

criteria.requirement: FEM mesh-convergence order reported and finest-mesh deviation from the analytic reference <= 3% (otherwise honest FAIL, not rounded away)
criteria.evidence: the deviation is measured on the last declared mesh level only; for simple support the reference is the exact analytic coefficient, for clamping it is the midpoint of the two-discretisation bracket and the bracket width is quoted alongside, so the clamped number is never presented as anchor agreement

verdict.note: the anchors are withheld, so this register certifies operator closure and FEM convergence; it does not certify agreement with DNV-RP-C201 or Timoshenko & Gere
